sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: The original notes that this species is highly variable and that the available series of measurements does not suffice to establish means or ranges for the individual measurements and ratios; only the following approximate ranges can be given (mm): body length (head projecting) 8.0—13.0; head length (including the projecting mandibles) 4.0—5.5; head length (to the frontoclypeal suture) 2.5—3.7; head width 1.&—2.5 (the OCR of the original has lost a digit; not conjectured); pronotum width 1.8—2.5; pronotum length 0.7—1.25.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Second-form queen: No. 483, Bulacan, Bulacan Province, Luzon, collected by Tansinsin, 5 April 1921 (month 4), in an orange tree ("In an orange tree"). Colour above yellow with a brownish tinge, paler below. Head, pronotum and other dorsal sclerites distinctly chitinized. Compound eyes large, conspicuous, projecting, entirely unpigmented, with a small white spot above each eye. Antennae broken off, but the base as in the nymph. A pale median longitudinal line and depressions distinct on the thoracic nota; small wing buds present; abdomen short; other characters as in the nymph of this species.
